plot: On Sunday noon Uncle Gus arrives three days early and Bup ends up in his paper bag of stale bread for the lake ducks; Zeek's Plan Pinecone swap gets thrown over the fence and Crispy is too heavy to climb the bench, so scared Pim climbs up with one minute left — the twist: Bup refuses rescue, because Mia packed him on purpose after hearing on the walkie that he had never seen a lake (planted at the start); Pim goes along to guard him, they come home muddy and happy, and Mom shouts that someone drew a face on her Thanksgiving pumpkin.

script.title: Thanksgiving Week: Bup Is Duck Food?!

beats.say: Uncle Gus came three days early. And Bup's in his bag!
Which bag? Pim, breathe. Which bag?
The duck bag! Old bread for the ducks at the lake!
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Sunday noon. Warm sun. A paper bag waits on the garden bench.
Every Thanksgiving week, Uncle Gus feeds stale bread to the lake ducks.
Guys? It's dark in here. And it smells like old crusts.
Stale bread. Bup is the stalest bread in the whole house.
And this morning he said he'd never seen a real lake.
The car leaves at twelve. Gus said so. Very loudly.
Then we need a swap. Plan Pinecone!
Zeek points at a fat brown pinecone under the maple tree.
Same color. Same size. Almost the same crust. Roll it!
Pim and Zeek roll the pinecone across the grass, huffing and puffing.
Then a giant shadow falls over them. Uncle Gus is back.
He picks up the pinecone, stares at it, and laughs like thunder.
Who puts pinecones on benches? He throws it over the fence.
That laugh! It's so l-loud! My whole bean is rattling!
Don't panic! He only went back inside for his car keys.
Five minutes to twelve. If that car leaves, Bup feeds the ducks!
Then I climb. Rocks are great at climbing.
Crispy grabs the bench leg. The whole bench wobbles. The bag tips.
Stop! One more wobble and Bup lands in the flower mud!
Too heavy. I'm a rock. Rocks are terrible at climbing.
Someone light has to climb that bag. Someone very, very light.
Slowly, everyone turns and looks at Pim.
N-n-nope. I'm a bean. Beans don't climb. Beans hide.
Pim, I believe in you. Also, it's really dark in here.
Pim takes one deep breath. He runs at the bench leg.
Up the leg. Over a crack. Onto the bench, shaking.
I'm up! I'm up! Don't look down, Pim. Don't look down!
Keys jingle. Footsteps on the porch. One minute left.
Bup! Grab my hand! I'll pull you out!
No. Pim, wait. Stop pulling.
Stop? You'll be duck food in thirty seconds!
I'm not duck food, Pim. I want to go.
Pim! Turn the bag around. There's writing on the back!
Pim spins the bag. Purple crayon letters. Mia's handwriting.
Not for ducks. This is Bup's trip to the lake. Love, Mia.
Mia packed him herself! The walkie was still on this morning!
She heard you, Bup. About never seeing a real lake.
My whole life in kitchens. Not one lake. Only the sink.
I didn't tell you. I thought you'd say it's too dangerous.
It IS dangerous! Ducks! Water! Uncle Gus's laugh!
The front door bangs. Pim looks at Bup, then down.
Fine. Then I'm coming too. Somebody has to guard you.
The most scared bean alive is going on a trip. Wow.
Mia runs out. She tucks Bup and Pim into her coat pocket.
The car rolls away. Two tiny faces peek out of the pocket.
Bring back a story! And Pim, please don't faint in the lake!
At sunset the car comes home. Two muddy, happy bros roll in.
I saw it. Real water. Bigger than ten thousand sinks.
And I fed a duck. A crust. From very, very far away.
Then Mom's voice booms from the kitchen window.
Who drew a face on my Thanksgiving pumpkin? Mia!
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

Uncle Gus arrives three days early, and Bup ends up in his bag of stale bread for the lake ducks. The car leaves at noon — and only the most scared bean in the house is light enough to climb up and get him.

es.title: Semana de Acción de Gracias: ¿Bup es comida de patos?! 🦆 (Ep 27)
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Toda mi vida en cocinas. Ni un lago. Solo el fregadero." — Bup
El tío Gus llega tres días antes y Bup acaba en su bolsa de pan duro para los patos del lago. El coche sale a mediodía, y solo el frijol más miedoso de la casa es lo bastante ligero para subir a buscarlo.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Semana de Ação de Graças: Bup virou comida de pato?! 🦆 (Ep 27)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"A vida toda em cozinhas. Nenhum lago. Só a pia." — Bup
O tio Gus chega três dias antes, e o Bup vai parar no saco de pão velho para os patos do lago. O carro sai ao meio-dia — e só o feijão mais medroso da casa é leve o bastante para subir e buscá-lo.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: أسبوع عيد الشكر: باب طعام للبط؟! 🦆 (Ep 27)
ar.description:
ماذا تتوقع أن يحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"حياتي كلها في المطابخ. ولا بحيرة واحدة. فقط الحوض." — باب
يصل العم غاس قبل ثلاثة أيام، وينتهي باب في كيس الخبز اليابس لبط البحيرة. السيارة تغادر عند الظهر — وأخوف حبة فاصولياء في البيت هي الوحيدة الخفيفة بما يكفي لتتسلق وتنقذه.
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Semaine de Thanksgiving : Bup donné aux canards ?! 🦆 (Ep 27)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la suite ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Toute ma vie dans des cuisines. Pas un seul lac. Juste l'évier." — Bup
Oncle Gus arrive trois jours en avance, et Bup finit dans son sac de pain rassis pour les canards du lac. La voiture part à midi… et seul le haricot le plus peureux de la maison est assez léger pour grimper le chercher.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: 感謝祭ウィーク：バップがアヒルのエサに!? 🦆 (Ep 27)
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「ずっとキッチン暮らし。湖なんて一度も見たことない。シンクだけ。」— バップ
ガスおじさんが3日早く到着。バップは湖のアヒル用の古いパン袋に入れられてしまった。車は正午に出発——袋によじ登れるほど軽いのは、家でいちばん怖がりの豆だけ。
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 추수감사절 주간: 법이 오리 밥이 된다고?! 🦆 (Ep 27)
ko.description:
다음 편에서 무슨 일이 일어날 것 같나요? 댓글로 알려 주세요.
"평생 부엌에서만 살았어. 호수는 한 번도 못 봤어. 싱크대뿐이었지." — 법
거스 삼촌이 사흘 일찍 도착하고, 법은 호수 오리에게 줄 딱딱한 빵 봉지에 들어가 버린다. 차는 정오에 떠나고, 봉지를 기어오를 만큼 가벼운 건 집에서 제일 겁 많은 콩뿐이다.
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Thanksgiving-Woche: Bup wird Entenfutter?! 🦆 (Ep 27)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Mein ganzes Leben in Küchen. Kein einziger See. Nur die Spüle." — Bup
Onkel Gus kommt drei Tage zu früh, und Bup landet in seiner Tüte mit altem Brot für die Enten am See. Um zwölf fährt das Auto – und nur die ängstlichste Bohne im Haus ist leicht genug, um hinaufzuklettern.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
